exact_semantic_reversion_rule: The target English value Crafting exactly matches G4. Restore the validated G4 translation for addon-owned locales where G4 has one; otherwise use the target English value.
fallback_rule: For these 33 added or changed entries, use exact target English when the target locale lacks a reliable already-validated exact-semantic translation. This deliberately favors correctness, placeholders and technical-token safety over invented low-confidence translations.
unchanged_reuse_rule: For each of the 53 unchanged key/value pairs, reuse the G5 project translation exactly when the addon owns the key. For a G6 upstream supplement locale, reuse a G5 project translation only if that exact unchanged key was project-owned in G5; otherwise fall back to target English instead of guessing the previous upstream translation.
mixed_locale_review_policy: The 40 non-full-fallback addon locales keep their validated G5 translations on unchanged keys but conservatively use target English on G6-only or changed semantics unless a safe reuse source is explicitly defined.
upstream_supplement_rule: Emit exactly the target normal keys missing from the pinned JEI 3.14.8 locale. Never duplicate an upstream-owned key. Reuse unchanged project-owned G5 translations where available; otherwise apply the same conservative target-English fallback policy.
debug_policy: The three upstream DEBUG description keys remain exactly English in every complete addon locale.
placeholder_policy: Preserve %s, %,d, %MODNAME, %CTRL and all technical literals exactly. The G6 English fallback strategy is specifically intended to make new placeholder-bearing strings fail-safe.
